```sql
SELECT poi_name, ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry::geography), 
                            (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cox Science Center and Aquarium%' LIMIT 1)::geography) AS bearing_degrees
FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
  AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, 
                  (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cox Science Center and Aquarium%' LIMIT 1)::geography) < 10000
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p.geometry::geography), 
                         (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cox Science Center and Aquarium%' LIMIT 1)::geography)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cox Science Center and Aquarium%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.park_name
FROM parks p
WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Dutch Harbor%' LIMIT 1))
  AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%UniSea Inn%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5
ORDER BY (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%UniSea Inn%' LIMIT 1) <-> p.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name
FROM pois
WHERE amenity = 'university'
  AND ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(geometry), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Proghorn Nature Area%' LIMIT 1)::geography) BETWEEN degrees(202.5) AND degrees(247.5)
  AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Aurora%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)::geography, 10000)
ORDER BY geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Proghorn Nature Area%' LIMIT 1)

    ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(p1.geometry::geography), ST_Centroid(p2.geometry::geography)) AS bearing_radians,

FROM pois p
JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%museum%'
  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%mankato%'
ORDER BY p.geometry::geography <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%bresnan arena%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name
FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
  AND ST_Intersects(
        geometry::geography,
        ST_Buffer(
          (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J. Pepin%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Portland%' LIMIT 1)::geography,
          10000
        )
      )
  AND ST_Y(geometry) <
      ST_Y(
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J. Pepin%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Portland%' LIMIT 1)
      )
ORDER BY geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J. Pepin%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Portland%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT park_name
FROM parks
WHERE ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Townsend%' LIMIT 1))
  AND leisure = 'golf_course'
  AND ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%3 Palms Zoo & Education Center%' LIMIT 1)), ST_Centroid(parks.geometry)) BETWEEN RADIANS(112.5) AND RADIANS(157.5)
ORDER BY parks.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%3 Palms Zoo & Education Center%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, z.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
JOIN (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Pine Grove Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Little Falls%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%'
    LIMIT 1
) z ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, z.geometry::geography, 10000)
WHERE p.amenity = 'university'
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(z.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> z.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%Meerkerk Gardens%' 
  AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Greenbank%' 
  AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%WA%' 
  AND p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(r.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography)) BETWEEN 180 AND 247.5
ORDER BY p.geometry::geography <-> r.geometry::geography
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Out of Africa Wildlife Park%' LIMIT 1) o
WHERE p.amenity = 'golf_course'
  AND ST_Azimuth(o.geometry, p.geometry) BETWEEN RADIANS(22.5) AND RADIANS(67.5)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> o.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT poi_name
FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
  AND ST_Intersects(
        geometry::geography,
        ST_Buffer(
          (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' LIMIT 1),
          10000
        )
      )
  AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(
        (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' LIMIT 1),
        pois.geometry
      )) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5
ORDER BY geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT ST_Distance(p1.geometry::geography, p2.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters,
       degrees(ST_Azimuth(p1.geometry, p2.geometry)) AS bearing_degrees,
       p2.poi_name AS stadium_name
FROM pois p1
JOIN pois p2 ON ST_Intersects(p2.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(p1.geometry::geography, 100000))
WHERE p1.poi_name ILIKE '%New Mexico Slaughter House%'
  AND p1.addr_city ILIKE '%Albuquerque%'
  AND p1.addr_state ILIKE '%NM%'
  AND p2.amenity = 'stadium'
ORDER BY bearing_degrees
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rolling Hills Asylum%' LIMIT 1) AS r
WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital'
  AND ST_Azimuth(r.geometry, p.geometry) BETWEEN RADIANS(247.5) AND RADIANS(292.5)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> r.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```
